documents.title: Master Services Agreement
documents.summary: Master Services Agreement between Acme Industrial Supplies Ltd. (Supplier) and Northwind Logistics GmbH (Customer) for delivery of industrial fasteners, fittings and packaging to Hamburg and Rotterdam. Effective 1 March 2026 with a 24-month initial term; covers fees, delivery, termination penalties, liability cap of EUR 250,000 and English law. Signed 20 and 21 February 2026.

enrich.detail: 7 section summaries, 13 facts, by the contract template

blocks.text: Master Services Agreement
Between Acme Industrial Supplies Ltd. ("Supplier"), 14 Foundry Lane, Leeds LS1 4AB, and Northwind Logistics GmbH ("Customer"), Hafenstrasse 22, 20457 Hamburg.
Effective date: 1 March 2026. Initial term: 24 months.
1. Scope of Services

The Supplier shall deliver palletised industrial fasteners, fittings and packaging materials to the Customer's warehouses in Hamburg and Rotterdam according to the weekly forecast provided by the Customer. Orders are placed in writing at least five (5) business days before delivery.
2. Fees and Payment
2.1 The Customer shall pay the unit prices listed in Schedule A. Prices are in EUR and exclude VAT.
2.2 Invoices are issued monthly in arrears and are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.
2.3 Payment shall be made by bank transfer to IBAN GB29 NWBK 6016 1331 9268 19, BIC NWBKGB2L.
3. Delivery and Acceptance
3.1 Delivery is DAP (Incoterms 2020) to the address stated in the order. Risk passes on delivery.
3.2 The Customer shall inspect goods within three (3) business days and notify the Supplier of any defect or shortfall in writing. Goods not rejected in that period are deemed accepted.
4. Termination
4.1 Notice. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving ninety (90) days' written notice, provided the notice does not expire before the end of the first twelve (12) months.
4.2 Cause. Either party may terminate immediately by written notice if the other party commits a material breach and fails to remedy it within thirty (30) days of being notified.
4.3 Early termination penalty. If the Customer terminates for convenience during the initial term, the following penalty applies:

| Termination date | Penalty |
| --- | --- |
| Months 13 - 18 | 15% of average monthly fees x remaining months |
| Months 19 - 24 | 8% of average monthly fees x remaining months |
| After month 24 | None |
5. Liability
5.1 The Supplier's aggregate liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, capped at EUR 250,000.
5.2 Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit or loss of goodwill.
5.3 Nothing in this Agreement limits liability for death, personal injury caused by negligence, or fraud.
6. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales. The courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction.

documents.title: Supplier Review Meeting
documents.summary: Minutes of a supplier review meeting dated 12 September 2026 between Acme and Northwind. It covers August on-time delivery of 94% against a 97% target, Northwind's request for the 6% volume discount tier to start at 200 pallets per month, and three action items with owners and due dates.

blocks.text: Supplier Review Meeting

Date: 12 September 2026
Attendees: Helen Marsh (Acme), Jonas Becker, Lena Vogt (Northwind)
Delivery performance
On-time delivery was 94% in August, below the 97% target. Two late pallets of pipe fittings were caused by a carrier strike in Rotterdam.
Pricing
Northwind asked for the 6% volume discount tier to start at 200 pallets per month. Acme will respond by 30 September.
Action items

| Owner | Action | Due |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Helen Marsh | Propose revised discount tiers | 2026-09-30 |
| Lena Vogt | Share Q4 volume forecast | 2026-09-25 |
| Jonas Becker | Review liability cap with legal | 2026-10-15 |
